title: Bollinger Bands
caption:
When these bands squeeze tight, pay attention.

Bollinger Bands are a 20-period average with a band two standard deviations either side. When the market goes quiet, they squeeze, and a squeeze often comes before a bigger move. It just won't tell you which way.

And touching the upper band isn't a sell signal on its own. Strong trends can ride it for a long time.

Bollinger Bands are one of the Pro indicators on Meme Street. Practise at memestreet.net

narration: When these bands squeeze tight, pay attention. Bollinger Bands are a twenty period moving average, with a band two standard deviations above and below it. They widen and narrow with volatility. When the market goes quiet, the bands squeeze together. A squeeze often comes before a bigger move. But it doesn't tell you which direction that move will go. And touching the upper band isn't a sell signal on its own. In a strong trend, price can ride the band for a long time. Bollinger Bands are one of the Pro indicators on Meme Street.
